skill.name: meituan-printer
skill.description: Manage and print formatted task slips on Meituan thermal printers over a local TCP network.
skill.summary: Print restaurant task slips, check printer reachability, manage templates, and schedule recurring thermal printer jobs.
skill.author: chenyangshu

security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate local-printer functionality, but it also exposes an unauthenticated web admin API on all network interfaces and can create OS-level scheduled tasks. Most static findings are Markdown, CSS, ESC/POS, or template-literal false positives, while persistence, exposed network binding, selected DOM XSS, and scheduler command construction are confirmed risks.

remediation.issue: Unauthenticated web admin server listens on 0.0.0.0.
remediation.suggestion: Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default, add authentication, and require explicit user opt-in before LAN exposure.

remediation.issue: System task export creates launchd and Windows scheduled tasks.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation for each export, show the exact task action, and provide clear removal controls.

remediation.issue: Task fields are inserted into plist and schtasks payloads without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Use plistlib for macOS plist generation and robust Windows argument quoting for scheduled task actions.

remediation.issue: Admin UI builds several views with innerHTML from editable data.
remediation.suggestion: Replace string-built HTML with DOM APIs or context-aware escaping for text, attributes, and event handlers.
Write logs under an application-owned directory with restrictive permissions or omit log files by default.

semantic_findings.title: Unauthenticated LAN-Exposed Admin API
semantic_findings.description: The Flask admin app binds to 0.0.0.0 and exposes printer, task, template, and system-export routes without authentication. Any user who can reach the local network port can modify printer state, trigger prints, or request scheduler export.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The route handlers have no authentication checks, and the app explicitly runs on host="0.0.0.0". Mutating endpoints include printer creation, task changes, immediate print execution, and OS scheduler export.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped Fields in System Scheduler Payloads
semantic_findings.description: Task title, printer alias, and content are interpolated into macOS plist strings and Windows scheduled task commands without escaping. Malformed task data can corrupt scheduler definitions or alter the executed command, especially through the unauthenticated export route.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scheduler payload is built by string interpolation from task_config fields. Those fields originate from web API task data and are not XML-escaped or command-escaped before export.

content.value_statement: Restaurant teams need fast task slips without manual formatting. This skill sends formatted jobs to local Meituan thermal printers and manages recurring print tasks.
actual_capabilities: Sends formatted ESC/POS task slips to a printer by alias or IP address.
Checks whether a configured printer is reachable on the local network.
Runs a local Flask web interface for printer, template, and task management.
Creates daily, weekly, or monthly print schedules with APScheduler.
Exports schedules to macOS launchd or Windows Task Scheduler.
Stores printer, task, type, and template data in local JSON files.
limitations: Printers must be reachable from the same local network as the host machine.
The web admin interface has no built-in authentication.
The scripts require Python and the Flask and APScheduler packages.
The print formatting targets Meituan or compatible ESC/POS thermal printers.

use_cases.title: Print Kitchen Task Slips
use_cases.description: Send a formatted checklist or work order to the kitchen printer before a shift starts.

use_cases.title: Maintain Printer Profiles
use_cases.description: Add, edit, test, and remove local printer aliases through a browser interface.

use_cases.title: Automate Recurring Checks
use_cases.description: Schedule daily, weekly, or monthly task slips for routine store procedures.

prompt_templates.title: Print a Simple Task Slip
prompt_templates.prompt: Print a task slip to the kitchen printer. Title it Morning Prep. Include these lines: check freezer temperature, prepare sauces, and confirm reservations.

prompt_templates.title: Check Printer Reachability
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether the printer named Kitchen is online. Tell me if the connection succeeds and what I should verify if it fails.

prompt_templates.title: Add a New Printer
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new printer named Front Desk with IP address 192.168.3.32 and port 9100. Test the connection before saving it.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Scheduled Print Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a daily 9:00 AM task slip for the Kitchen printer. Use the title Opening Checklist and include prep, sanitation, and stock checks.

output_examples.input: Print a test slip to Kitchen with the title Printer Test.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms the target printer, sends the formatted slip, and reports whether the printer accepted the connection.

output: Kitchen printer with its local IP and port.
Front Desk printer with its local IP and port.
Any saved printer type or note.

output_examples.input: Schedule the closing checklist every night at 10:00 PM.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a recurring task, stores it locally, and can optionally export it to the operating system scheduler.

best_practices: Run the web admin server only on a trusted local network.
Use printer aliases instead of typing IP addresses for routine jobs.
Test each printer connection before creating recurring print tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the web admin port to public networks.
Do not export system tasks before testing a one-time print run.
Do not store sensitive customer or payment data in print templates.

faq.question: What printer type does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets Meituan thermal printers and similar ESC/POS printers reachable over TCP.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Printing uses the local network. The start scripts may install Python packages if they are missing.

faq.question: Can I manage multiple printers?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill stores printer aliases, IP addresses, ports, types, and notes in local configuration files.

faq.question: Can it schedule recurring print jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports daily, weekly, and monthly schedules through the local web admin interface.

faq.question: Is the web admin interface protected by a password?
faq.answer: No. Run it only on trusted networks or add authentication before broader deployment.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
